Tech Stack: Uses Bun, Hono, SQLite (via bun:sqlite), React, Tailwind CSS, and Recharts as requested.2. Database Schema: The database initialization in src/db/index.ts creates the required users, sessions, diary_entries, tags, and diary_tags tables with correct foreign keys and unique constraints.3. Backend API: Implements all required endpoints (Auth, CRUD, Timeline, Calendar, Stats) with proper authentication middleware and user isolation (queries always filter by user.id).4. Frontend Pages: Provides a high-quality SPA with Login/Register, Timeline, Editor (with 7-level mood selection), Detail view, Calendar (with mood highlights), and a Statistics dashboard with interactive charts.5. Security: Passwords are hashed using Bun.password.hash, and data access is isolated per user.6. Commercial Quality: The UI is modern and responsive, utilizing shadcn/ui-like components (cards, buttons, inputs) and includes a functional Light/Dark mode toggle.7. Testing: A comprehensive test suite in tests/api.test.ts covers all blocking requirements, including password hashing, token generation, CRUD with tags, descending timeline, filtering, user isolation, and cleanup logic.8. Build and Run: The project builds with vite build and runs as a single process via bun run index.ts, serving both the API and static frontend.- — evaluation_config: The Moment Diary Commercial MVP has been successfully delivered. This is a full-stack, single-process application built with Bun, Hono, React (Vite), and SQLite, designed for high performance and a premium user experience.### Key Features- Modern Tech Stack:   - Backend: Bun + Hono + bun:sqlite for extreme performance and developer simplicity.  - Frontend: React + Tailwind CSS + Lucide React + Recharts for a commercial-grade, responsive UI.- Authentication: Secure email/password registration and login using Bun.password hashing and Bearer token session management.- Diary Management: Full CRUD capabilities for diary entries, including:  - Mood Selection: 7 levels of mood tracking with expressive emojis.  - Smart Tagging: Automatic normalization (lowercase) and many-to-many tag relationships.  - Favorites: Mark entries as favorites for quick filtering.- Visual Insights:  - Timeline: A clean, reverse-chronological list of entries with tag and mood filtering.  - Calendar: A monthly grid highlighting entry counts and primary moods for each day.  - Statistics: Dashboard with interactive charts for mood distribution, top tags, and current recording streaks.- Premium UI/UX:  - Dark/Light Mode: Full theme support with automatic system preference detection and manual toggle.  - Responsive Design: Mobile-first layout that looks beautiful on phones, tablets, and desktops.  - Polished Interactions: Smooth transitions and modern card-based components.### Implementation Details- Project Structure: A unified codebase where the Bun/Hono server serves both the REST API and the static frontend build from a single process.- Database Schema: 5 optimized tables (users, sessions, diary_entries, tags, diary_tags) ensuring data integrity and user isolation.- Security: Strict user isolation for all data access and secure password management.- Testing: A comprehensive test suite in tests/api.test.ts covering all P0 scenarios including Auth, CRUD, isolation, and tag logic.### Quick StartTo run the application:1. Ensure [Bun](https://bun.sh) is installed.2. Build the frontend: bun run build3. Run the application: bun run index.ts4. Access the app at: http://localhost:3000The application is now fully operational and ready for deployment as a commercial-grade MVP.目标评估- ✅ Project Scaffolding & Database Schema: src/db/migrate.ts defines tables 'users', 'sessions', 'diary_entries', 'tags', and 'diary_tags' with correct constraints. src/db/index.ts initializes the SQLite database at 'data/moment-diary.db'.- ✅ Authentication & Security Middleware: src/api/auth.ts uses Bun.password.hash/verify for credentials and generates hex session tokens. src/middleware/auth.ts implements Bearer token validation and populates context user. User isolation is verified in tests/api.test.ts (Test 8).- ✅ Diary Management (CRUD) & Editor UI: src/api/diaries.ts implements CRUD. PATCH updates 'updated_at' (verified in tests/api.test.ts line 148). src/client/pages/Editor.tsx provides a 7-level mood selector and tag input with normalization.- ✅ Timeline & Filtering Logic: src/api/diaries.ts and src/api/stats.ts (timeline endpoint) support filtering by tag, mood, and favorite status. tests/api.test.ts verifies descending order (Test 5) and filtering (Tests 6 & 7).- ✅ Calendar, Stats & Theme Support: src/api/stats.ts implements calendar and stats logic. src/client/pages/Calendar.tsx uses a 7-column grid with mood highlights. src/client/pages/Stats.tsx uses Recharts for visualization. Tailwind dark mode is implemented in globals.css.- ✅ Full-Stack Integration & Deployment: index.ts uses Hono to serve API routes and serveStatic for './dist'. SPA fallback is implemented at lines 24-32. package.json includes 'bun run index.ts' for startup.重规划建议- 根因：N/A - Project accepted.- 策略：N/A
